title: Email at 256 characters
why: Tests the upper boundary of the email length limit.

steps.does: POST …/identity/register-user with an Email exactly 256 characters long, built as 64 'a' characters, '@', then a domain of three 63-character labels joined by dots (63+1+63+1+63 = 191 characters). UserName long.email, FirstName Anna, LastName Meyer, PassPortNumber DE9876543, Password Str0ng!Pass1, matching ConfirmPassword.

expect: Registration succeeds. The saved Email and NormalizedEmail are both exactly 256 characters, with no truncation.
